    Notion Agents use your existing docs and databases as context. They run inside Notion and connect across Slack, Mail, Calendar, and more! No rebuilding knowledge, no switching apps.

    Custom Agents

    Each Custom Agent gets its own permissions, just like a teammate. You decide what it can read and write across Notion, Slack, Mail, Calendar, and MCP integrations.

    Notion Agent

    Inherits your permissions, so it can see what you see. It can search across your workspace and connected tools to take action in Notion.

    Built for enterprise confidence

    Notion Agents are built to be safe and transparent by design. Every agent run is logged, and all changes are reversible.

    Admin controls and analytics

    Workspace admins can monitor Custom Agent usage and Notion credit consumption. Every agent run is logged with full audit trails showing what triggered it, what it did, and why.

    Configurable permissions

    Notion Agent inherits your permissions. Custom Agents offer page-level access control.

    Reversible changes

    Built on Notion's collaboration layer. Undo any change with version history.

    Your data stays private

    Notion doesn't train AI models on your content. Enterprise customers get zero data retention.

    Secure development practices validated by SOC 2 and ISO certifications, including threat modeling, security reviews, and continuous testing.

    Prompt injection protection

    Enhanced detection of hidden commands in uploaded files, flags suspicious links for user approval, and gives admins control over external content.

    Questions & answers

    What are Custom Agents?

    Custom Agents automate recurring work for your entire team. One person sets up a workflow: what data to pull, how to format it, where to post it. Set a trigger or schedule, and the agent handles it from there—24/7, whether you're online or not. One person builds it, and the whole team benefits. Learn more.

    What's the difference between Custom Agents and Notion Agent?

    Custom Agents are team-wide AI teammates that run automatically on schedules or triggers. Notion Agent is a personal AI assistant that works on-demand when you ask. All Notion users get Notion Agent. Business and Enterprise customers get Custom Agents, priced under the Notion credit system.

    Who can create Custom Agents?

    Anyone on a Business or Enterprise plan, including Business trials, can create Custom Agents by default. Business and enterprise admins can limit who can create them from the admin dashboard.

    What tools and integrations are compatible with Custom Agents?

    Slack: Read and post messages in public channels. Trigger agents from emoji reactions and mentions. Private channels coming soon.

    Mail: Read, organize, and draft emails automatically. Agents can apply labels, sync emails to Notion databases, and run on triggers like new emails from specific senders. Learn more.

    Calendar: View your schedule, find meeting times, and create or update events. Agents can prep you for meetings, coordinate availability across participants, and run on triggers like event created, updated, or cancelled. Learn more.

    Notion MCP: Connect to external apps via the Model Context Protocol. Use pre-configured partner integrations, including Linear, Figma, HubSpot, Ramp, Wiz, Stripe, GitHub, Intercom, Amplitude, Attio, and Sentry. Or connect too any custom MCP server (including internal tooling) with the Custom MCP connection. Learn more.

    What can admins control with Custom Agents?

    Business and Enterprise admins have visibility and control over how Custom Agents are used across their workspace. You control who can create agents, what each agent can access, and can disable them at any time. Every run is logged, so changes are visible and reversible.

    Manage who can create agents. Set creation permissions in Settings → Notion AI.

    Disable agents anytime. Stop all runs, edits, and chats for any agent.

    View all workspace agents and their access. See every agent, what it can access, and who created it.

    Track Notion credit usage. Monitor real-time usage, see which agents consume the most credits, and get notified at 80% and 100%.

    Is my data secure with Custom Agents?

    Yes. Agents follow your permissions, every run is logged, and all changes are reversible. Notion doesn't train AI models on your content, and Enterprise customers get zero data retention.

    How do Notion credits work?

    Business and Enterprise plans give each workspace member a set amount of Notion AI credits each month. Additional usage via Notion credits is a separate, workspace-managed balance your admin can turn on so you can keep going once your Standard or Select credits run out.

    • Standard credits: Used for work where Notion picks the model for you. Each member gets 1,500 Standard credits a month.*

    • Select credits: Used for work where you pick the model yourself, or use a Custom Agent that isn’t funded by your workspace. Each member gets 500 Select credits a month.*

    * Your included amount may vary depending on your plan and purchase arrangement.

    Learn more about Notion credits

    How much do Custom Agents cost?

    Business and Enterprise plans include two kinds of AI credits for each member: Standard credits and Select credits. By default, a Custom Agent uses its owner’s Select credits, even when other people use it. A workspace admin can instead fund an agent with a monthly budget of Notion credits, and can set budgets and spending controls for each agent.
